title: A Meeting in an Office
prompt: Describe the picture in as much detail as you can. You will have 45 seconds to prepare and 30 seconds to speak.
image_description: A bright modern conference room. Five people in business clothes sit around a long wooden table. In the foreground, a woman with short dark hair is pointing at a laptop screen that shows a bar chart, while a man beside her takes notes in a notebook. On the far side of the table, two colleagues are listening and one is smiling. A glass of water, a few documents and a pair of glasses are on the table. In the background, a whiteboard with diagrams covers the wall, and large windows let in sunlight.

Across the table, two other colleagues are listening carefully, and one of them is smiling. There are documents and a glass of water on the table. In the background, I can see a whiteboard on the wall and large windows. It seems that they are discussing a project or sales results.

**Mẹo Describe a Picture (45 giây chuẩn bị, 30 giây nói):**
- Cấu trúc 3 bước: **(1) Câu tổng quát** (địa điểm + hoạt động chính) -> **(2) Chi tiết người/vật** (vị trí: in the foreground/background, on the left/right) -> **(3) Nhận xét/kết luận** ("It seems to be...").
- Dùng thì **hiện tại tiếp diễn** cho hành động: "A man is holding...".
- Không biết tên vật? Mô tả công dụng hoặc dùng từ chung ("some equipment"). Đừng im lặng.
- Dành khoảng 20 giây cho chi tiết, 5 giây cho câu mở đầu và kết.

title: Survey: Shopping Habits
prompt:
Imagine that a marketing firm is conducting a telephone survey about shopping habits.
Question 1: How often do you go shopping for clothes?
Question 2: Do you prefer to shop online or in stores?
Question 3: Describe the last time you bought something expensive. What was it, and why did you buy it?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually go shopping for clothes about once a month, mostly when the seasons change.
Q2: I prefer shopping in stores because I can try things on and check the quality before I pay.
Q3: The last expensive item I bought was a laptop for work. My old one was very slow and often froze during meetings, so I compared several models online for a week. I chose one with a faster processor and a longer battery life, and it has helped me finish tasks much more efficiently.
tips_md:
**Mẹo Respond to Questions (không chuẩn bị; câu 1-2: 15 giây, câu 3: 30 giây):**
- Trả lời **ngay câu đầu tiên** bằng câu hoàn chỉnh, rồi thêm 1 lý do hoặc ví dụ.
- Dùng lại **từ khóa trong câu hỏi** để mở đầu nhanh ("I usually...", "Yes, I do because...").
- Câu 3 (30 giây) thường cần ý kiến hoặc mô tả: nêu quan điểm -> lý do -> ví dụ ngắn.
- Giữ **tốc độ ổn định**, không cần từ vựng quá phức tạp; ngữ pháp đúng và rõ ý quan trọng hơn.

| Thu, Oct 9 | Factory visit | Pick-up at hotel, 8:30 A.M. |
| Fri, Oct 10 | Return flight | Departs 1:15 P.M. |

Questions:
1. What time will Ms. Dubois arrive in Singapore?
2. Where is she staying?
3. Could you describe her schedule for Wednesday?
sample_answer:
Q1: Ms. Dubois will arrive in Singapore at five fifty-five in the evening on Tuesday, October seventh.
Q2: She is staying at the Marina Suites hotel.
Q3: On Wednesday, October eighth, she has two events. In the morning at ten o'clock, she will have a client meeting at Tanner Corp. Then at seven in the evening, she will have dinner with Mr. Lim.
tips_md:
**Mẹo Respond Using Information (đọc 45 giây; trả lời câu 1-2: 15 giây, câu 3: 30 giây):**
- Khi đọc lịch/chương trình, **gạch chân giờ, ngày, địa điểm, tên và điều kiện đặc biệt**.
- Trả lời **chỉ dùng thông tin trong bảng**; đọc chính xác số liệu, đừng tự suy diễn.
- Câu có bẫy ("Is there a session at 3 P.M.?") -> trả lời "No, but..." và đưa thông tin gần nhất.
- Câu 3 thường yêu cầu **tổng hợp nhiều dòng** (ví dụ "tóm tắt các buổi vào buổi sáng"): nói theo thứ tự thời gian.

title: Working from Home
prompt: Some people think working from home is better than working in an office. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
sample_answer: In my opinion, working from home is better for most people. The main reason is that it saves time and money. For example, I used to spend two hours commuting every day, and now I can use that time to exercise or spend with my family. Another reason is that it is quieter at home, so I can concentrate on difficult tasks. Of course, an office is useful for teamwork, but with video calls we can still communicate well. That is why I believe working from home is a better choice.
tips_md:
**Mẹo Express an Opinion (15 giây chuẩn bị, 60 giây nói):**
- Cấu trúc **PREP**: Point (nêu quan điểm) -> Reason (lý do) -> Example (ví dụ cá nhân) -> Point (nhắc lại kết luận).
- Dùng cụm nối: "In my opinion...", "The main reason is...", "For example...", "That's why I believe...".
- Chọn quan điểm **dễ giải thích**, không cần là quan điểm thật của bạn.
- Chuẩn bị 2 lý do; mỗi lý do 1-2 câu. Nói đến hết giờ, kết bằng câu tóm tắt.
